changeSummary: Adds a visible-on-focus skip link and WAI-ARIA tab semantics to the 12-section admin dashboard. Keyboard navigation supports ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End with wrapping and keeps selected state, roving tabindex and hidden tab panels synchronized.
acceptanceCriteria: The admin dashboard exposes a skip link to its section navigation.
The 12 section buttons form one named tablist with one selected tab and roving tabindex.
Each tab references exactly one tabpanel and each tabpanel references its controlling tab.
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight wrap through tabs; Home and End move to the first and last tab.
Only the selected panel is exposed; inactive panels carry hidden state.
Existing admin API calls and authorization remain unchanged.
No migrations, data writes, deployment or served bundle changes are introduced.
